product_one_liner.value: NodeZero is an autonomous penetration-testing platform that safely simulates real-world attacks to reveal and prioritize exploitable risks for security teams, enabling them to fix and verify remediation.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage describes safe real-world attack simulation; the about/home material characterizes NodeZero as autonomous pentesting.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage exposed a public pricing page link.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in their respective customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: The company leadership page did not provide an employee count and no reliable cited band was established.

hq_location.notes: Company about page states it is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

founded_year.notes: Company about page states Horizon3 was founded in 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows predominantly product use cases, security advice, and marketing/editorial posts; it does not establish at least two engineer-authored posts explaining product architecture, infrastructure, ML/data, incidents, or open-source development.

public_docs.notes: The company links to a public documentation site for its product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company job board search listing includes Applied AI Engineer and Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Autonomous Defense. The company careers page likewise indexed those roles.

model_provider.notes: No public statement naming a model or model provider was found in the reviewed homepage, docs/trust search results, or blog search results.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center is the designated security and trust resource; publicly named certifications identified in company material include SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement dated August 3, 2026 states a $250 million Series E.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 Series E falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Job board lists a role titled Hybrid Account Executive, MSP (and search results also showed a Senior Account Executive posting).

launched_6mo.notes: The October 15, 2026 announcement of Horizon3 and Torq closing the remediation loop presents a product integration/capability release within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Matthew Schaner was appointed VP of Sales, Americas on July 7, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Marketing Operations Manager posting specifically names CRM Salesforce and marketing automation platform Pardot.
